ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: BizimResimler uses the camera to scan event QR codes and take photos for the shared album.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BizimResimler lets you choose photos and videos to add to an event album.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BizimResimler saves event photos and videos you download to your photo library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BizimResimler uses the microphone to record sound with videos for the event album.
